Having crossed the finish line of her 
Debut race, Marvelous Sunday seemed as 
though her excitement would never cool 
down.

Influenced by her, the Umamusume who ran 
alongside her also became positive. Seeing 
this, Marvelous Sunday felt confident in 
what she had achieved.

However, the wall of the Twinkle Series 
was steep. In order to spread the 
Marvelous, she would need real ability 
that delivered solid results.

With that in mind, the initial goal was 
set: gain more experience through races 
and steadily build up a fanbase.
